<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>BJP Rajya Sabha nominations:</strong> The BJP has officially announced nine candidates for the Rajya Sabha across six states, signaling the party&#x27;s strategic focus on strengthening its legislative presence.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNaVhocTRXcTFZVHNGTHZRVEYyZXBfM0VIa0wzbUNUaGJjRS0zeEV6akpHUmxOMmhyaHRMNERTWW4td2hkMW8zcUZnR1poMllnUnJ1YjYycEZ4T052T2p6YjhRell2R1RHU0doVHo0d1AtdGE2dHBhM3dheUVwcUZtRmRDU3B6UDdKSnc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legal challenges in high-profile cases:</strong> The CBI is challenging the discharge of Arvind Kejriwal and Manish Sisodia in the liquor policy case, while the Supreme Court prepares to hear the Ram Mandir donation matter.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political discourse on national identity:</strong> BJP leadership has launched a sharp critique against the Congress party, alleging disrespect toward &#x27;Vande Mataram&#x27; amid ongoing debates over national symbols.</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Viksit Bharat policy framework:</strong> NITI Aayog has outlined the &#x27;Sapta Dhaara&#x27;—seven high-priority streams—to guide India&#x27;s policy focus toward achieving the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Infrastructure and sector growth:</strong> The government has mandated new insurance requirements for nuclear operators, while NITI Aayog emphasizes that the telecom and network equipment sector requires urgent policy support to double its GDP contribution.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
